title: Arrays grow when you add to them
statement: An array gets bigger by itself when you store something past its end, so its size does not need to be decided in advance.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: predict a write one past the end of an array
evidence_patterns.signature: predicts the array now has one more element

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items; the learner treats arrays like lists. A slip is a single off-by-one index.

conflicts_with.label: An array has a fixed length set when it is created

resolved_by.label: An array has a fixed length set when it is created
